To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a novel hybrid system for human face recognition that combines a self organizing map, a convolutional neural net, and local image sampling, that this system outperforms a multilayered perceptron and the Karhunenko Loève transform, that we have analyzed its computational complexity and shown how it can be reduced, and that we have shown how new classes of faces can be added to the system.
we present a new hybrid neural network for face recognition that combines local image sampling and a self organizing map neural network with a convolutional neural net.
the hybrid network performs well, is robust to changes in expression, pose and facial details, and is computationally feasible.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a system that can recognize a face, even when it is not in the same pose or orientation as when the image was originally acquired.
the development of an intelligent system that can recognize human faces in unconstrained environments.
the problem of recognizing human faces in a real-time, robust and accurate way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our hybrid system is superior to the MLP and the SOM in terms of recognition rate and computational complexity, and comparable to the convolutional network in terms of recognition accuracy.
the proposed hybrid system is a very good compromise between accuracy and complexity.
the hybrid system is superior to the MLP system, and is comparable to the best of the SOM systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present an approach that is robust and efficient, and which can be used in real time applications.
the hybrid system performs better than the other systems.

the convolutional neural networks have a better recognition performance and a better generalization capability than the MLPs, while SOMs are more robust and computationally efficient than the Karhunenk-Loeve transforms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
convolutional networks provide an efficient way to combine local and global features, and are a powerful tool for pattern recognition.
the hybrid system outperformed both of the other methods in the experiments we ran.
the convolutional neural networks are very effective in recognizing human faces.
